audit.evidence: Real official DataEase images v2.10.1/v2.10.23/v2.10.24 + MySQL 8.0 + redis 6.2 on Docker; external HTTP POST /de2api/dataVisualization/findById with forged JWTs. Observed: residual X-DE-LINK-TOKEN signed with hardcoded 'link-pwd-fit2cloud' -> 200+flag @2.10.23, 401 signature-invalid @2.10.24 (wrong-key 401 and real generated-key 200 controls confirm key-specificity); original X-DE-TOKEN signed with '83d923...' -> 200+flag @2.10.1, 401 signature-invalid @2.10.23. See repro.log. NOTE: v0=2.10.1 community core performs no JWT signature verification (wrong-key also 200), i.e. the pre-2.10.2 state; the CVE-2024-52295 fix added verification with a generated secret. The residual/incomplete-fix leg (the CVE-2026-57172 pair) is fully key-specific.

provenance.notes: Sibling-sink incomplete fix of the same hardcoded-HMAC-key anti-pattern: CVE-2024-52295 patched the main-auth signing key (SubstituleLoginConfig.tokenSecret via generated secret) but left the ShareLink signing key ShareSecretManage.defaultPwd hardcoded as 'link-pwd-fit2cloud' until CVE-2026-57172 (2.10.24) replaced it with a random per-install secret. Gate passed on real Docker; see repro.log.
